html:
<form (submit)="submit($event)">
  <cs-field label="Subject"><input csInput [value]="value().subject" /></cs-field
  ><cs-field label="Body">
    <textarea csTextarea maxlength="5000">{{ value().body }}</textarea>
  </cs-field>
  @if (value().delivery === 'scheduled') {
    <cs-field label="Schedule"><cs-date-time-field /></cs-field>
  }
  <button csButton="secondary" type="button" (click)="previewRequested.emit(value())">
    Preview</button
  ><button csButton type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
